newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa head sees good second half.
newsitem.headline: Axa head sees good second half.

text.p: The chairman of French insurer Axa SA, Claude Bebear, said on Wednesday he expected a good second half but added that it would "be a bit optimistic" to expect it to match the first half.

"In general terms, the second half will be good," he told an analysts' meeting. But on the question of matching the first-half performance,"we would like it to be so but I can't promise it; it would be even a little optimistic."
The company earlier reported net attributable profit up 51.8 percent to 1.98 billion francs in the the first half.
